ops.body:
Redrive of this task found a previous attempt already in a sound state — adopted, did not duplicate.

- Issue filed: https://github.com/yasyf/synckit/issues/1 ("syncservice: typed Client.Call escape hatch for custom methods")
- Implementation already existed on branch `sk-typed-call` (worktree at /private/var/folders/vb/xzk1nd0d7hx63b4n22n5383r0000gn/T/synckit-sk-typed-call.UlfDqc, repo /Users/yasyf/Code/synckit), commit bcdd8ef701b9e50ec24345fad327569c15481a06 "feat(syncservice): add typed custom RPC calls".
- New API: `func (c *Client) Call(ctx context.Context, method string, params map[string]any, out any) error` — reuses the existing private `call` helper, so error/decode semantics match every built-in method exactly. One-line godoc present.
- Fully covers credpull's usage: internal/hostsync/credpull.go's current pattern (`tx.Do(ctx, &rpc.Request{Method: MethodFetchCredential, Params: {"uuid": uuid}})` + manual resp.OK check + json.Unmarshal into CredentialEnvelope) maps 1:1 to `client.Call(ctx, MethodFetchCredential, map[string]any{"uuid": uuid}, &env)`. Nothing credpull needs is left unexpressed.
- Tests: syncservice/client_call_test.go, table-driven, covers positive decode, remote error (method named in error), transport error (errors.Is-wrapped), decode error (wraps *json.UnmarshalTypeError), and nil-out discard.
- Gates: `task ci` (vet, golangci-lint — 0 issues, `go test -race -count=1 ./...` — all packages green, build) all pass clean in the worktree.
- Not pushed to origin and cc-pool NOT modified — left for orchestrator review before credpull migrates onto it, per instructions.
